title: Resource metrics analysis
description: Deep-dives into performance metrics for a specific resource during troubleshooting or capacity planning.
example_prompt: "Pull the key metrics for resource '{resource_id}' over the last 4 hours with 5-minute granularity. Include CPU, memory, disk IOPS, network in/out, and any resource-specific metrics. Highlight any values exceeding 80% of the resource limit."
